text: haha rats.... the entire painting is fucked [Image #10] but it is stored correctly in the editor still, i did just check
resolution: Root-caused the scrambled placed painting: the paint island layout rewrites the DISPLAYED mesh's UVs into atlas space (framework/gpu/3d.zig setPaintDetail 'rewrites the resident mesh UVs in place'), but the package's mesh blobs (base.blob/doc.blob via __model_mesh_write/__model_meshdoc_write) persist model_source verts with ORIGINAL UVs — two different UV spaces, so req_2832's atlas embed sampled the island-packed base.png through source UVs and produced the squashed strip. Fix: new host door __model_painted_mesh_write writes the displayed paint-space verts; writeModelArtifacts persists them as mesh/painted.blob beside atlases/base.png on every save/export; pushResidentMeshes pairs painted.blob verts with the PNG (and for packages saved before the writer existed ships the doc mesh FLAT — honest fallback, never scrambled). Needs a dev-host rebuild (new Zig door), then one re-save/re-export of bridge_foot to materialize painted.blob.
